title: Map non-Citizen-DJ LoC paths to recordings
description: Extend recording_key() in crates/apricity-data/src/migration.rs for loc/<collection>/... paths, spec first in features/data.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done and verified by reviewer: recording_key maps loc/<coll>/Title_<id> -> rec_<coll>_<id> (collection loc/<coll>) and ccmixter/<author>/Title_<id> -> rec_ccmixter_<id> (collection ccmixter/<author>); a .clean.wav copy shares its original's recording and inherits its sources.json entry (credits, excerpt start). cargo test -p apricity-data: 89+16+1+15+1 pass. A fresh migration of the repo yields one uploads recording (announcer). Commit 7322bb2.
